verdict.rationale: MX's Platform API/OpenAPI spec supports the core banking-agent tasks (connect sessions via Connect Widget/Platform API, balances, transactions, account aggregation, connection management via webhooks/dashboard) and a probe finds a documented MCP endpoint at docs.mx.com/mcp, suggesting an MCP surface exists. However there is no detail on what the MCP server exposes, no documentation of scoped/limited credentials for agent use (API keys are only described as rotatable, not scope-restricted), and no first-party description of an 'agent' or AI-native operating mode. missing for 10: documented MCP tool/capability list, scoped-credential mechanism for agent access, explicit agent/AI use-case guidance.
